Can I add an item to an order I already placed?

Once an order is placed, we are unable to add or remove items, or make any changes to it. This is because our system begins processing orders immediately to get them to you as quickly as possible. 🙂

If you'd like to get more items, you can always place a new order for them.

turns.q: What happens if it already shipped — can it still be changed?
turns.replyTail:
Specialist

What happens if it already shipped — can it still be changed?

Once an order has shipped, we are unfortunately unable to make any changes to it.

As all sales are final, we cannot modify, cancel, or refund orders once they have been placed. The only exception is the 30-minute window immediately after ordering, during which you can update your shipping address through your order dashboard.

We hope you love your pieces when they arrive! 🙂
